Every line of DeWitt’s family, on one map.
The Hutchinses leave Broadwindsor for Salem after 1712, and move by generations through Dudley and Pomfret to Vermont,
Malone and Fort Covington, on the Canadian line.
The Watsons come from Dalserf in Scotland to Trout River, Quebec.
The Southworths start at Leiden, among the Pilgrims, and go by Plymouth, Duxbury,
Little Compton and Mansfield to Bangor, New York.
The Soules cross on the Mayflower in 1620; their descendants reach Wayne County,
Pennsylvania. The Buchers come from Switzerland to Milton and Watsontown, in Pennsylvania.
The Snyders are at DeWitt, New York, by 1849, and the Hammonds at Olean.
All of them end in one household, at Stamford, Connecticut.
